---- MODULE W4Od15m2p3t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Slots == {"s1", "s2"}
Brokers == {"b1", "b2"}
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES owner, votes, phase, prop, inbox

vars == <<owner, votes, phase, prop, inbox>>

Votes == {"yes", "no"}
Phases == {"idle", "voting", "committed", "aborted"}

Init ==
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ votes = [b \in Brokers |-> NONE]
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ prop = [slot |-> NONE, part |-> NONE]
    /\ inbox = {}

Propose(s, b) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ owner[s] = NONE
    /\ prop' = [slot |-> s, part |-> b]
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ votes' = [x \in Brokers |-> NONE]
    /\ inbox' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED owner

CastVote(b, v) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ ~ \E m \in inbox : m.part = b
    /\ votes[b] = NONE
    /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {[part |-> b, v |-> v]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, votes, phase, prop>>

Deliver(m) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ m \in inbox
    /\ votes[m.part] = NONE
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![m.part] = m.v]
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, phase, prop>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \A b \in Brokers : votes[b] = "yes"
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![prop.slot] = prop.part]
    /\ phase' = "committed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, prop, inbox>>

Abort ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \E b \in Brokers : votes[b] = "no"
    /\ phase' = "aborted"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, votes, prop, inbox>>

Reset ==
    /\ phase \in {"committed", "aborted"}
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ prop' = [slot |-> NONE, part |-> NONE]
    /\ votes' = [b \in Brokers |-> NONE]
    /\ inbox' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED owner

Quiesce ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ \A s \in Slots : owner[s] # NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Slots, b \in Brokers : Propose(s, b)
    \/ Quiesce
    \/ \E b \in Brokers, v \in Votes : CastVote(b, v)
    \/ \E m \in inbox : Deliver(m)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Slots -> Brokers \cup {NONE}]
    /\ votes \in [Brokers -> Votes \cup {NONE}]
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ inbox \subseteq [part : Brokers, v : Votes]

NoDoubleAlloc ==
    (phase = "voting") => (owner[prop.slot] = NONE)

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl:
A stock-exchange opening auction assigns each cleared price slot to exactly one
participating broker. Because a slot must never be handed to two brokers, the
matching engine uses two-phase commit: a coordinator proposes allocating a
particular slot to a particular broker, every broker returns a yes/no vote, and
only a unanimous yes lets the coordinator commit the allocation. Vote messages
travel over an unordered fabric, so they may be delivered to the coordinator in
any order (they accumulate in a set and are processed one at a time). The
coordinator only opens voting on a slot that is still free; once a slot is owned
it is never reproposed. A round ends in commit, abort, or reset back to idle.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No voting round is ever opened on a slot that already has an owner, so the same slot is never allocated twice.

---- MODULE W4Od11m7p0t5 ----
EXTENDS FiniteSets

Workers == {"w1", "w2"}
FREE == "free"
ADMIN == "admin"
Ids == Workers \cup {ADMIN}

VARIABLES reg, inside, wanting, adminBusy

vars == <<reg, inside, wanting, adminBusy>>

Init ==
    /\ reg = FREE
    /\ inside = {}
    /\ wanting = {}
    /\ adminBusy = FALSE

Register(w) ==
    /\ w \notin wanting
    /\ w \notin inside
    /\ wanting' = wanting \cup {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, inside, adminBusy>>

Cas(w) ==
    /\ w \in wanting
    /\ reg = FREE
    /\ reg' = w
    /\ wanting' = wanting \ {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inside, adminBusy>>

Enter(w) ==
    /\ reg = w
    /\ w \notin inside
    /\ inside' = inside \cup {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, wanting, adminBusy>>

Leave(w) ==
    /\ w \in inside
    /\ reg = w
    /\ inside' = inside \ {w}
    /\ reg' = FREE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<wanting, adminBusy>>

AdminSeize ==
    /\ ~adminBusy
    /\ reg' = ADMIN
    /\ inside' = {ADMIN}
    /\ adminBusy = FALSE
    /\ adminBusy' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED wanting

AdminRelease ==
    /\ adminBusy
    /\ reg = ADMIN
    /\ reg' = FREE
    /\ inside' = {}
    /\ adminBusy' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED wanting

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Register(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Cas(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Enter(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Leave(w)
    \/ AdminSeize
    \/ AdminRelease

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ reg \in Ids \cup {FREE}
    /\ inside \subseteq Ids
    /\ wanting \subseteq Workers
    /\ adminBusy \in BOOLEAN

MutexHeldByRegister ==
    \A x \in inside : reg = x

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MutexHeldByRegister
nl:
A print-shop job spooler protects the single physical imagesetter with a
compare-and-swap ownership register. The register holds either "free" or the id
of the current owner. A press worker that wants the imagesetter first registers
interest, then attempts an atomic compare-and-swap that only succeeds if the
register still reads "free"; on success the register now names that worker, who
may enter the critical section, run the plate, and later compare-and-swap the
register from its own id back to "free". A privileged shop administrator can
override at any time: the admin seizes the register (setting it to "admin"),
evicting whoever was inside, does its maintenance, and later releases it back to
"free". Only the identity currently named in the register may be inside.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Everyone occupying the critical section is exactly the id currently held in the ownership register, so at most one agent uses the imagesetter.

---- MODULE W4Od11m4p4t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences

Kinds == {"color", "mono"}
Ceiling == 3
MaxDone == 3
MaxRej == 2

VARIABLES queue, cap, done, rejected

vars == <<queue, cap, done, rejected>>

Init ==
    /\ queue = << >>
    /\ cap = 1
    /\ done = 0
    /\ rejected = 0

Admit(k) ==
    /\ Len(queue) < cap
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, k)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, done, rejected>>

Refuse(k) ==
    /\ Len(queue) = cap
    /\ rejected < MaxRej
    /\ rejected' = rejected + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, cap, done>>

Press ==
    /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ done < MaxDone
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ done' = done + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, rejected>>

Grow ==
    /\ cap < Ceiling
    /\ cap' = cap + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, done, rejected>>

Shrink ==
    /\ cap > Len(queue)
    /\ cap > 1
    /\ cap' = cap - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, done, rejected>>

Quiesce ==
    /\ Len(queue) = Ceiling
    /\ cap = Ceiling
    /\ done = MaxDone
    /\ rejected = MaxRej
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E k \in Kinds : Admit(k)
    \/ Quiesce
    \/ \E k \in Kinds : Refuse(k)
    \/ Press
    \/ Grow
    \/ Shrink

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ queue \in Seq(Kinds)
    /\ cap \in 1..Ceiling
    /\ done \in 0..MaxDone
    /\ rejected \in 0..MaxRej

CapacityRespected ==
    /\ Len(queue) <= cap
    /\ cap <= Ceiling

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityRespected
nl:
A print-shop spooler buffers incoming print jobs in a bounded work queue that
applies backpressure. Each arriving job is either "color" or "mono". The queue
has a live capacity that the shop supervisor can retune at runtime: it can be
grown up to a hard ceiling, or shrunk to save memory. A new job is admitted only
when the current queue length is strictly below the live capacity; otherwise the
job is refused (backpressure) and counted as rejected. A press pulls the oldest
job from the head of the queue and completes it. Shrinking the capacity is only
permitted down to a value that still covers everything currently buffered, so a
runtime shrink can never strand queued work above the new limit.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of buffered jobs never exceeds the live capacity, and the live capacity never exceeds the hard ceiling.

---- MODULE W4Od1m2p6t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Controllers == {"c1", "c2", "c3"}
Authorized == {"c1", "c2"}
MaxEpoch == 2

VARIABLES cEpoch, pEpoch, phase, votes, acted

vars == <<cEpoch, pEpoch, phase, votes, acted>>

Init ==
    /\ cEpoch = 0
    /\ pEpoch = [c \in Controllers |-> 0]
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ votes = [c \in Controllers |-> "none"]
    /\ acted = {}

Reconfigure ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ cEpoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ cEpoch' = cEpoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pEpoch, phase, votes, acted>>

Sync(c) ==
    /\ pEpoch[c] < cEpoch
    /\ pEpoch' = [pEpoch EXCEPT ![c] = cEpoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cEpoch, phase, votes, acted>>

OpenRound ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ votes' = [c \in Controllers |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cEpoch, pEpoch, acted>>

Vote(c) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ c \in Authorized
    /\ pEpoch[c] = cEpoch
    /\ votes[c] = "none"
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![c] = "yes"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cEpoch, pEpoch, phase, acted>>

Clear(c) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ c \in Authorized
    /\ pEpoch[c] = cEpoch
    /\ votes[c] = "yes"
    /\ acted' = acted \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cEpoch, pEpoch, phase, votes>>

Close ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ acted' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cEpoch, pEpoch, votes>>

Next ==
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Sync(c)
    \/ OpenRound
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Vote(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Clear(c)
    \/ Close

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ cEpoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ pEpoch \in [Controllers -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "voting"}
    /\ votes \in [Controllers -> {"none", "yes"}]
    /\ acted \subseteq Controllers

OnlyAuthorizedCurrentActed ==
    \A c \in acted :
        /\ c \in Authorized
        /\ pEpoch[c] = cEpoch

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OnlyAuthorizedCurrentActed
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator coordinates a runway grant using two-phase
commit across a set of tower controllers. Only controllers on the authorized
roster may take part, and each carries an epoch tag that must match the
coordinator's current epoch; when the coordinator reconfigures (bumps its
epoch), a controller becomes stale until it re-synchronizes. A controller can be
slow to re-synchronize but does not fail outright, so a lagging controller
simply holds an old epoch for a while. During a commit round the coordinator
collects votes and then lets controllers perform the physical clearance action,
but a controller may perform that action only if it is on the roster and its
epoch currently matches the coordinator. Unauthorized or stale controllers are
refused. Every actor recorded as having acted must have been authorized and
current at the moment it acted.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every controller that has performed a clearance action is on the authorized roster and holds the coordinator's current epoch.

---- MODULE W4Od2m1p5t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences, FiniteSets

Crates == {"c1", "c2", "c3"}
RingA == <<"a1", "a2">>
RingB == <<"b1", "b2">>

VARIABLES pool, shipped, tokA, tokB

vars == <<pool, shipped, tokA, tokB>>

NextInRing(ring, r) ==
    LET i == CHOOSE k \in 1..Len(ring) : ring[k] = r
    IN ring[(i % Len(ring)) + 1]

Init ==
    /\ pool = Crates
    /\ shipped = {}
    /\ tokA = "a1"
    /\ tokB = "b1"

ShipA(r, c) ==
    /\ r = tokA
    /\ c \in pool
    /\ pool' = pool \ {c}
    /\ shipped' = shipped \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokA, tokB>>

ShipB(r, c) ==
    /\ r = tokB
    /\ c \in pool
    /\ pool' = pool \ {c}
    /\ shipped' = shipped \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokA, tokB>>

PassA ==
    /\ tokA' = NextInRing(RingA, tokA)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, shipped, tokB>>

PassB ==
    /\ tokB' = NextInRing(RingB, tokB)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, shipped, tokA>>

Quiesce ==
    /\ pool = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in pool : ShipA(tokA, c)
    \/ \E c \in pool : ShipB(tokB, c)
    \/ PassA
    \/ PassB
    \/ Quiesce

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ pool \subseteq Crates
    /\ shipped \subseteq Crates
    /\ tokA \in {"a1", "a2"}
    /\ tokB \in {"b1", "b2"}

ShipOnce ==
    /\ shipped \cap pool = {}
    /\ shipped \cup pool = Crates

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ShipOnce
nl:
A warehouse runs two independent robot fleets that draw from one shared pool of
crates. Within each fleet a single token circulates around a ring of robots;
only the robot currently holding its fleet's token may reach into the shared
pool and ship a crate. Shipping is irreversible: once a crate leaves on a truck
it is gone from the pool for good and must never be shipped a second time, not by
the same fleet nor by the other. A robot passes its token to the next robot in
its ring when done. Because both fleets pull from the same pool, the shipped-set
and the remaining pool must stay disjoint at all times.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No crate is simultaneously present in the shared pool and in the shipped set, so each crate is shipped at most once.

EXTENDS Integers

Nodes == {"n1", "n2", "n3"}
MaxEpoch == 2

VARIABLES epoch, grantee, learned, operating

vars == <<epoch, grantee, learned, operating>>

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ grantee = "n1"
    /\ learned = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]
    /\ operating = {}

Reconfigure(g) ==
    /\ operating = {}
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ grantee' = g
    /\ UNCHANGED <<learned, operating>>

Learn(n) ==
    /\ learned[n] < epoch
    /\ learned' = [learned EXCEPT ![n] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, grantee, operating>>

Begin(n) ==
    /\ n = grantee
    /\ learned[n] = epoch
    /\ operating = {}
    /\ operating' = {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, grantee, learned>>

Finish(n) ==
    /\ n \in operating
    /\ operating' = operating \ {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, grantee, learned>>

Next ==
    \/ \E g \in Nodes : Reconfigure(g)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Learn(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Begin(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Finish(n)

    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ grantee \in Nodes
    /\ learned \in [Nodes -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ operating \subseteq Nodes

    \A n \in operating :
        /\ n = grantee
        /\ learned[n] = epoch

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ExclusiveGrantee
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser shares one robotic dispensing arm among
several controller nodes. Access is governed by epoch-numbered reconfiguration:
a supervisor periodically advances the epoch and, for that epoch, designates
exactly one controller as the grantee. Each controller caches the epoch it last
learned; a controller can be slow to learn the new epoch (it lags) but it never
crashes. A controller may begin operating the arm only if it is the grantee for
the coordinator's current epoch and it has learned that epoch; it stops when
done. A lagging controller therefore cannot start, because its cached epoch is
behind. At any instant every controller operating the arm must be the current
epoch's grantee holding the current epoch.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every controller currently operating the arm is the designated grantee of the current epoch and has learned that epoch, so no two controllers ever operate the arm at once.

---- MODULE W4Od6m3p1t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences

Banks == {"east", "west"}
Assignments == {"g1", "g2", "g3"}
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES log, acked, leader, pending

vars == <<log, acked, leader, pending>>

Init ==
    /\ log = << >>
    /\ acked = {}
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ pending = [by |-> NONE, item |-> NONE]

Elect(b) ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ leader' = b
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, acked, pending>>

Fail ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, acked, pending>>

Prepare(a) ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ pending.item = NONE
    /\ a \notin acked
    /\ pending' = [by |-> leader, item |-> a]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, acked, leader>>

Commit ==
    /\ pending.item # NONE
    /\ pending.by = leader
    /\ log' = Append(log, pending.item)
    /\ acked' = acked \cup {pending.item}
    /\ pending' = [by |-> NONE, item |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED leader

DropStale ==
    /\ pending.item # NONE
    /\ pending.by # leader
    /\ pending' = [by |-> NONE, item |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, acked, leader>>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Elect(b)
    \/ Fail
    \/ \E a \in Assignments : Prepare(a)
    \/ Commit
    \/ DropStale

LogItems == { log[i] : i \in 1..Len(log) }

TypeOK ==
    /\ log \in Seq(Assignments)
    /\ acked \subseteq Assignments
    /\ leader \in Banks \cup {NONE}
    /\ pending.item \in Assignments \cup {NONE}
    /\ pending.by \in Banks \cup {NONE}

NoLostUpdate ==
    acked = LogItems

====

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
Two elevator banks in a skyscraper share one dispatch record, an append-only log
of committed floor assignments. At any time one bank is elected leader and is the
only one permitted to commit an assignment; the other stands by. A commit is
two-step: the leader first prepares an assignment, then commits it, which
atomically appends it to the shared log and marks it acknowledged. Leaders can
fail over: the current leader may drop out (leadership becomes vacant) and a bank
is then elected leader. A prepared assignment carries the identity of the bank
that staged it, and it may only be committed while that same bank is still the
leader; after a failover to the other bank, a leftover prepared assignment is
refused. This guarantees no acknowledged assignment is ever dropped from the log.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The set of acknowledged assignments equals exactly the set of assignments present in the shared log, so no committed update is ever lost.

nl:
A subway signalling system controls a closed loop of three track blocks around
which a fixed set of trains circulates. A single signalling controller is elected
leader and is the only authority that may authorize a train to advance from its
block to the next block in the loop. Advancing is done in two steps: the leader
proposes a move of one train from a source block to the adjacent block, then the
move is executed, decrementing the source and incrementing the destination. The
leader may fail over: it can drop out (leadership vacant) and later a controller
is elected; each election advances a bounded configuration generation. A
controller can be slow to take leadership, during which no train moves, but it
does not vanish. Trains are never created or destroyed as they circulate.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The total number of trains summed across all three blocks always equals the fixed fleet size.

    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> FREE]
    /\ mailbox = {}
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ inflight = [feeder |-> NONE, slot |-> NONE]

Request(f, s) ==
    /\ [feeder |-> f, slot |-> s] \notin mailbox
    /\ mailbox' = mailbox \cup {[feeder |-> f, slot |-> s]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, leader, inflight>>

    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, mailbox, inflight>>

Failover ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, mailbox, inflight>>

    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ inflight.slot = NONE
    /\ m \in mailbox
    /\ owner[m.slot] = FREE
    /\ inflight' = m
    /\ mailbox' = mailbox \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, leader>>

Commit ==
    /\ inflight.slot # NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![inflight.slot] = inflight.feeder]
    /\ inflight' = [feeder |-> NONE, slot |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mailbox, leader>>

    \/ \E n \in {"c1", "c2"} : Elect(n)

    /\ mailbox \subseteq [feeder : Feeders, slot : Slots]
    /\ leader \in {"c1", "c2", NONE}
    /\ inflight.feeder \in Feeders \cup {NONE}
    /\ inflight.slot \in Slots \cup {NONE}

    inflight.slot # NONE => owner[inflight.slot] = FREE

NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAllocation
nl:
A power-grid load shedder allocates scarce shed slots to feeders during an
overload. One control node is elected leader and is the sole authority that
grants a slot; it can fail over, with leadership going vacant and later filled.
Feeders send shed requests naming a feeder and a slot, and these requests travel
over a lossy fabric that may reorder them, so they pile up in an unordered
mailbox from which the leader picks in any order. To grant, the leader takes one
request whose target slot is still free, marking that grant in flight, and then
commits it, recording the slot as owned by that feeder. A slot, once owned, is
never regranted, so no slot is ever allocated to two feeders.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a grant is in flight, the slot it targets is still free (unowned), so the same slot is never allocated twice.

    /\ UNCHANGED <<available, reserved>>

Failover(i) ==
    /\ leader[i] # NONE
    /\ leader' = [leader EXCEPT ![i] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<available, reserved, gen>>

Reserve(i) ==
    /\ leader[i] # NONE
    /\ available > 0
    /\ available' = available - 1
    /\ reserved' = reserved + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, gen>>

Release(i) ==
    /\ leader[i] # NONE
    /\ reserved > 0
    /\ reserved' = reserved - 1
    /\ available' = available + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, gen>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances, s \in Servers : Elect(i, s)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Failover(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Reserve(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Release(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ available \in 0..Copies
    /\ reserved \in 0..Copies
    /\ leader \in [Instances -> Servers \cup {NONE}]

    available + reserved = Copies

nl:
A library book reservation system keeps a fixed number of copies of a title,
tracked as an available tally and a reserved tally. Two independent branch
instances share this single copy pool. Each instance runs its own leader
election: at any time an instance either has an elected leader server or its
leadership is vacant, and only an instance that currently has a leader may act on
the pool. Acting means either reserving (moving one copy from available to
reserved) or releasing (moving one copy from reserved back to available). Either
instance's leader can fail over, vacating that instance's leadership until a
server is re-elected; each election advances a bounded generation counter. Copies
are never created or destroyed; they only shift between the available and
reserved tallies.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The available tally plus the reserved tally always equals the fixed number of copies.

bounded generation. Riders submit assignment requests naming a rider and a target

in an unordered mailbox from which the leader picks in any order. The leader
assigns a picked request into its target car only while that car is below
capacity; riders also alight, freeing space. A car's load never exceeds its
capacity.

    /\ record = {}
    /\ acked = {}
    /\ holder = NONE
    /\ leaseExp = 0
    /\ clock = 0

Acquire(p) ==
    /\ holder = NONE
    /\ leaseExp' = clock + LeaseLen
    /\ holder' = p
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, acked, clock>>

Commit(b) ==

    /\ clock < leaseExp
    /\ b \notin record
    /\ record' = record \cup {b}
    /\ acked' = acked \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, leaseExp, clock>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, acked, holder, leaseExp>>

Expire ==
    /\ holder # NONE
    /\ clock >= leaseExp
    /\ holder' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, acked, leaseExp, clock>>

Crash ==
    /\ holder # NONE
    /\ holder' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, acked, leaseExp, clock>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Acquire(p)
    \/ \E b \in Books : Commit(b)
    \/ Tick
    \/ Expire
    \/ Crash

    /\ acked \subseteq Books
    /\ holder \in Patrons \cup {NONE}

    /\ clock \in 0..MaxClock

    acked \subseteq record

NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostReservation
nl:
A library book reservation system guards its shared reservation record with
lease-based ownership. A patron client acquires a lease naming itself as the
current owner with an expiry deadline set a fixed span ahead of the current
clock. Only the client holding an unexpired lease may commit a reservation,
which records the book into the shared reservation set and, in the same step,
acknowledges the reservation back to the patron. The clock ticks forward; once
it reaches the lease's expiry the lease is expired and ownership becomes vacant,
free to be reacquired. A client can also crash silently at any time, abandoning
its lease without warning. Whether a lease ends by expiry or by a silent crash,
every acknowledged reservation remains present in the shared record.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every acknowledged reservation is present in the shared reservation record, so no acknowledged update is ever lost, even across lease expiry or a silent crash.

---- MODULE W4Od10m2p3t2 ----
EXTENDS FiniteSets

Instances == {"ins1", "ins2"}
Blocks == {"blk1", "blk2"}
Trains == {"tA", "tB"}
Interlocks == {"s1", "s2"}
FREE == "free"
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES owner, phase, prop, approved

vars == <<owner, phase, prop, approved>>

Init ==
    /\ owner = [b \in Blocks |-> FREE]
    /\ phase = [i \in Instances |-> "idle"]
    /\ prop = [i \in Instances |-> [blk |-> NONE, train |-> NONE]]
    /\ approved = [i \in Instances |-> {}]

Propose(i, b, t) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "idle"
    /\ owner[b] = FREE
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "voting"]
    /\ prop' = [prop EXCEPT ![i] = [blk |-> b, train |-> t]]
    /\ approved' = [approved EXCEPT ![i] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED owner

Vote(i, s) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "voting"
    /\ s \notin approved[i]
    /\ approved' = [approved EXCEPT ![i] = approved[i] \cup {s}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, phase, prop>>

Commit(i) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "voting"
    /\ approved[i] = Interlocks
    /\ owner[prop[i].blk] = FREE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![prop[i].blk] = prop[i].train]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "done"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<prop, approved>>

Abort(i) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "voting"
    /\ owner[prop[i].blk] # FREE
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, prop, approved>>

Reset(i) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "done"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, prop, approved>>

Quiesce ==
    /\ \A b \in Blocks : owner[b] # FREE
    /\ \A i \in Instances : phase[i] # "voting"
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ Quiesce
    \/ \E i \in Instances, b \in Blocks, t \in Trains : Propose(i, b, t)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, s \in Interlocks : Vote(i, s)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Commit(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Abort(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Reset(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Blocks -> Trains \cup {FREE}]
    /\ phase \in [Instances -> {"idle", "voting", "done"}]
    /\ approved \in [Instances -> SUBSET Interlocks]

CommittedOwnershipStands ==
    \A i \in Instances :
        phase[i] = "done" => owner[prop[i].blk] = prop[i].train

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CommittedOwnershipStands
nl:
A subway signalling system allocates exclusive occupancy of track blocks to
trains. Two independent signalling instances share one pool of blocks, and each
instance runs its own two-phase commit round: an instance proposes granting a
particular block to a particular train (only starting a round on a block it sees
as free), its participating interlockings all vote to approve, and the instance
then commits the grant only if the block is still free, recording the block as
owned by that train. Because both instances draw from the same block pool, the
second instance's commit is refused if the block was taken in the meantime. Once
a block has been committed to a train, that ownership stands: it is never
overwritten by another train.
SAFETY PROPERTY: For every committed round, the block it granted is still owned by exactly the train that round granted it to, so the same block is never allocated to two different trains.

---- MODULE W4Od16m5p2t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Pharmacists == {"ph1", "ph2", "ph3"}
Total == 2
Quorum == 2

VARIABLES stock, dispensed, active, approved, alive

vars == <<stock, dispensed, active, approved, alive>>

Init ==
    /\ stock = Total
    /\ dispensed = 0
    /\ active = FALSE
    /\ approved = {}
    /\ alive = Pharmacists

OpenRequest ==
    /\ ~active
    /\ stock > 0
    /\ active' = TRUE
    /\ approved' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, dispensed, alive>>

Vote(p) ==
    /\ active
    /\ p \in alive
    /\ p \notin approved
    /\ approved' = approved \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, dispensed, active, alive>>

Dispense ==
    /\ active
    /\ Cardinality(approved) >= Quorum
    /\ stock > 0
    /\ stock' = stock - 1
    /\ dispensed' = dispensed + 1
    /\ active' = FALSE
    /\ approved' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED alive

Restock ==
    /\ dispensed > 0
    /\ dispensed' = dispensed - 1
    /\ stock' = stock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<active, approved, alive>>

Crash(p) ==
    /\ p \in alive
    /\ Cardinality(alive) > Quorum
    /\ alive' = alive \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, dispensed, active, approved>>

Next ==
    \/ OpenRequest
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists : Vote(p)
    \/ Dispense
    \/ Restock
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists : Crash(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ stock \in 0..Total
    /\ dispensed \in 0..Total
    /\ active \in BOOLEAN
    /\ approved \subseteq Pharmacists
    /\ alive \subseteq Pharmacists

UnitConservation ==
    stock + dispensed = Total

====

NEXT Next
INVARIANT UnitConservation
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser tracks a controlled drug as an in-stock count
and a dispensed count; units only move between these two tallies and are never
created or destroyed. Every dispense must clear quorum voting: a request to
dispense one unit is opened, on-duty pharmacists cast approval votes, and once a
quorum of approvals is present one unit moves from stock to dispensed. Units can
also be restocked, moving one unit from dispensed back to stock. Any pharmacist
may crash silently, dropping out of the on-duty set without notice, but enough
pharmacists always remain on duty to still form a quorum. No matter how units are
dispensed or restocked, the in-stock and dispensed tallies always account for
every unit.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The in-stock count plus the dispensed count always equals the fixed total number of units.

EXTENDS FiniteSets

Slots == {"sl1", "sl2", "sl3"}
Robots == {"r1", "r2"}
Controllers == {"p1", "p2"}
FREE == "free"
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES owner, enabled, phase, prop, votes

vars == <<owner, enabled, phase, prop, votes>>

Init ==
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> FREE]
    /\ enabled = Slots
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ prop = [slot |-> NONE, robot |-> NONE]
    /\ votes = {}

Enable(s) ==
    /\ s \notin enabled
    /\ enabled' = enabled \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, phase, prop, votes>>

Disable(s) ==
    /\ s \in enabled
    /\ owner[s] = FREE
    /\ ~(phase = "voting" /\ prop.slot = s)
    /\ enabled' = enabled \ {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, phase, prop, votes>>

Propose(s, r) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ s \in enabled
    /\ owner[s] = FREE
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ prop' = [slot |-> s, robot |-> r]
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, enabled>>

Vote(p) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ p \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, enabled, phase, prop>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ votes = Controllers
    /\ prop.slot \in enabled
    /\ owner[prop.slot] = FREE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![prop.slot] = prop.robot]
    /\ phase' = "done"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<enabled, prop, votes>>

Reset ==
    /\ phase = "done"
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, enabled, prop, votes>>

Quiesce ==
    /\ \A s \in Slots : owner[s] # FREE
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Enable(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Disable(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots, r \in Robots : Propose(s, r)
    \/ \E p \in Controllers : Vote(p)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Reset
    \/ Quiesce

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Slots -> Robots \cup {FREE}]
    /\ enabled \subseteq Slots
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "voting", "done"}
    /\ prop.slot \in Slots \cup {NONE}
    /\ prop.robot \in Robots \cup {NONE}
    /\ votes \subseteq Controllers

NoDoubleAlloc ==
    phase = "voting" => owner[prop.slot] = FREE

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet allocates storage slots to robots using two-phase commit
across a set of participant controllers. The set of usable slots changes at
runtime: the warehouse can enable a currently unusable slot or disable a usable
one, but a slot may only be disabled while it is free, so no robot is ever
stranded. To allocate, a coordinator proposes granting an enabled, free slot to a
robot, the participants unanimously vote to approve, and the coordinator then
commits only if the slot is still enabled and free, recording it as owned by that
robot. A slot that is already owned is never reproposed, so while a voting round
is open its target slot is guaranteed still free.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a voting round is open, the slot it targets is still free (unowned), so the same slot is never allocated to two robots.
